cloze_items_sentence.name: cloze_items_sentence
cloze_items_sentence.value: ("cloze_items"."sentence" is null) = ("cloze_items"."blank_start" is null) and ("cloze_items"."sentence" is null) = ("cloze_items"."blank_end" is null) and ("cloze_items"."sentence" is not null or "cloze_items"."origin" = 'generated') and ("cloze_items"."example_id" is not null) = ("cloze_items"."origin" = 'example')

cloze_items_translation.name: cloze_items_translation
cloze_items_translation.value: "cloze_items"."translation" is null or "cloze_items"."sentence" is not null

phrase_pictures_stock.name: phrase_pictures_stock
phrase_pictures_stock.value: "phrase_pictures"."stock_id" is null or ("phrase_pictures"."status" = 'ready' and "phrase_pictures"."theme" is not null and "phrase_pictures"."stock_id" ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$')

phrase_pictures_file.name: phrase_pictures_file
phrase_pictures_file.value: ("phrase_pictures"."status" = 'ready') = ("phrase_pictures"."file" is not null) and ("phrase_pictures"."file" is null or "phrase_pictures"."file" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and ("phrase_pictures"."file" is null) = ("phrase_pictures"."content_type" is null)

phrase_pictures_description.name: phrase_pictures_description
phrase_pictures_description.value: "phrase_pictures"."status" not in ('pending', 'ready') or "phrase_pictures"."description" is not null

phrases_complete_or_pending.name: phrases_complete_or_pending
phrases_complete_or_pending.value: ("phrases"."text" is not null and "phrases"."norm" is not null) or ("phrases"."text" is null and "phrases"."norm" is null and "phrases"."meaning_norm" is not null)

picture_stock_concepts_origin.name: picture_stock_concepts_origin
picture_stock_concepts_origin.value: ("picture_stock_concepts"."origin" = 'admin' and "picture_stock_concepts"."source_file" is null and "picture_stock_concepts"."kids_safe" is null) or ("picture_stock_concepts"."origin" = 'drawing' and "picture_stock_concepts"."source_file" is not null and "picture_stock_concepts"."source_file" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

reading_corrections_word.name: reading_corrections_word
reading_corrections_word.value: char_length("reading_corrections"."word") between 2 and 8 and char_length("reading_corrections"."key") between 2 and 8

shared_readings_word.name: shared_readings_word
shared_readings_word.value: char_length("shared_readings"."word") between 2 and 8 and char_length("shared_readings"."key") between 2 and 8
